decisions.reason: The pandemic collapse in air travel pushed the firm's aviation-security performance far below aspiration and left little slack, so a standalone check-in app with no visible market presence since 2019 is a likely target when problemistic search refocuses resources on the core screening business.

PassBoard was the firm's flagship passenger-processing launch and fits the post-COVID demand for contactless, efficient processing as air traffic recovers in 2022, so management will likely keep it despite tight slack.

Self-service check-in supports airlines' touchless recovery needs and can be merged with the PassBoard platform, so it is likely kept for now, though its uncertain results and the firm's low slack make it vulnerable.
